اعتكدن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَكَدْنَ (iʕtakadna) /iʕ.ta.kad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اُعْتُكِدْنَ (uʕtukidna) /uʕ.tu.kid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اِعْتَكِدْنَ (iʕtakidna) /iʕ.ta.kid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
